notes.title: Immediate Reaction Update
notes.content:
We've completely [b]rewritten the codebase[/b] to pinpoint bugs lurking in the depths of code interactions. After some time and testing, we've managed to come up with the second major update for the "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3766130/Mirror_Atelier]Mirror Atelier[/url]".

[b]Biggest Changes in This Update[/b]
[list]
[*] The reshuffle mechanism has been rewritten to improve the performance of random walks.
[*] A Gameplay Settings group has been added to the Options screen.
New options added with this change are:
[b]Show Puzzle Secret:[/b] Helps you identify missing piece position by making it semi-visible.
[b]Use Sliding Tiles:[/b] If you don't prefer [u]animations[/u] or find them time-consuming, you can [u]now disable them[/u].
[b]Show Narrative:[/b] If you don't prefer [u]narration[/u] or find it time-consuming, you can [u]now disable them[/u]. You can still read the narratives [u]in the Stories screen[/u] after you complete the relevant stages.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes in This Update[/b]
[list]
[*] Inconsistent state of the "Show/Hide Tile Order" button : [b]Fixed[/b]
When the stage changes, the tile labels' visible state is now maintained.
When the Collection screen is used to start a new level, the tile labels' visible state is also maintained.
[*] Story snippets do not immediately unlock after completing their corresponding level : [b]Fixed[/b]
[*] Strength and Justice achievements in Moon Shade Tarot are not achievable : [b]Fixed[/b]
[/list]

Enjoy the new features and fixes!


[b]Do Not Forget to Wishlist The Game[/b]
If this is the first time you are seeing the game, you can visit our Store Page and add "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3766130/Mirror_Atelier]Mirror Atelier[/url]" to your wishlist in order to increase the game's wishlist number. This would increase our morale by ensuring that the game is get to be noticed by more people.

Also don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Besinci-Kural-AS]Steam Page[/url] for our other titles.

notes.title: Stories Screen Feature Added
notes.content:
We are introducing a brand-new [b]Story Reading Screen[/b] feature that will make the game experience more complete. Previously scattered throughout puzzles, story elements will now become a more coherent experience.

The Stories screen is a simplified way to engage with the game's ever enriching lore and narratives, allowing players to revisit stories and [u]read[/u] key plot points [u]whenever they want[/u].

The [b]Stories Screen[/b] interface features a chronological progression of the series and will be enriched with the stories you acquire.

[b]Note: [/b][u][i]The serie about cats will still make no sense.[/i][/u]

We hope this feature will foster a greater appreciation for the narrative efforts put into the game, encouraging players to delve deeper and connect more profoundly with its mysteries.

Enjoy the new feature.


[b]Do Not Forget to Wishlist The Game[/b]
If this is the first time you are seeing the game, you can visit our Store Page and add "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3766130/Mirror_Atelier]Mirror Atelier[/url]" to your wishlist in order to increase the game's wishlist number. This would increase our morale by ensuring that the game is get to be noticed by more people.

Also don't forget to follow us on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Besinci-Kural-AS]Steam Page[/url] for our other titles.

notes.title: New Story for Moon Shade Tarot Serie
notes.content:
Changes in this patch:

- [b]New story [/b]for the "[u]Moon Shade Tarot[/u]" series added.
- [b]Stories screen[/b] added for [u]conveniently reading stories after acquiring[/u] them.

Each puzzle in the "Moon Shade Tarot" is now part of an [i]ongoing story.[/i]

Reading all of them after acquiring them may be a good option as well.

Enjoy the new story.

notes.title: New serie "Moon Shade Tarot"
notes.content:
Changes in this patch

- New puzzle serie of "Moon Shade Tarot" added.
- Magical Cats series merged into first serie.

Each puzzle in the "Moon Shade Tarot" serie is bound to an achievement.

Enjoy the new puzzles.

notes.title: Fix for unsolvable combinations issue
notes.content:
[p]Fixed the unsolvable combinations issue by [b]changing the shuffle mechanism[/b] from a [u]mathematically-based[/u] parity checking one to a [u]brute-force-based[/u] one that shuffles by [b]making a random walk of the blank tile[/b].

Also, we added [b]tile order display[/b] and [b]reshuffle on demand[/b] options to the puzzle board for convenience.

If you still encounter any [u]unsolvable combinations[/u] (which should be [u]practically impossible now[/u] with the random walk shuffle mechanism), just make the number labels visible, take a screenshot, and send it to us so we can understand and solve the problem.

[i]Enjoy the enhanced challenge and seamless gameplay.[/i][/p]
